title: AnnotatedDraft
description: The validation stage's artifact of record (P8, B34(11)): every claim rendered with tier + verification status, every finding with its disposition — the answer to review fatigue (T8). Data-only at P8; the P9 review UI renders it. Written ONLY at completion (B34(13): a partial verdict set must never dishonestly unblock packaging — the deliberate inverse of the draft envelope's prepass skeleton). Prose is NOT duplicated here: drafts/draft.json remains the prose of record, and every field is code-assembled from whitelist-gated wires — nothing model-written lands unverified.

draft_sha256.description: sha256 of drafts/draft.json as validated — a revised draft voids the annotation by mismatch, not by convention (the T6 binding pattern, one link down the chain).

plan_sha256.description: Echoed from the draft envelope: the Gate-2 plan this chain descends from.

revision_n.description: Echoed from the draft envelope revision this annotation describes.

validated_at.description: The injected ISO datetime the staleness clock ran against (B34(6)) — no wall-clock; byte-determinism holds.

packaging.description: Code-derived packaging state (never model-written): the Q2 control's summary. blocked = any Tier-1 claim in a blocking status remains unwaived.

ranked_fixes.description: Buyer Red-Team output, ADVISORY (B34(9)): no gate consumes it, no acceptance clause names it. Ranks re-derived by code from wire order.

sections.description: One entry per draft-envelope section, in the buyer's order — every section appears, including the ones no check reached (v1 ledger_rows shape: absent-means-absent, a default becomes a claim on screen).

section_type.description: Echoed from the draft envelope; run-log validation lines carry the same value on target (13 metrics slice on it).

draft_status.description: Echoed from the draft envelope. Only drafted sections carry claims; the others appear so their absence from auditing is visible, not silent.

claims.description: Extracted claims with audit outcomes — the per-claim receipts behind the section-grain run-log validation records (B34(3)).

slot_id.description: Path A: which answer the claim came from.

text.description: Verbatim from the delivered prose — extraction is code-gated to containment (B34(5)); a claim not present in the prose was dropped-and-reported, never annotated.

text_digest.description: Matches claim_text_digest on the run-log claim_audit line for the deciding claim.

status.description: Audit outcome. Verdicts are the enum, never confidence scores (B34(2)); waived preserves the original verdict in reasons. not_audited = Tier-2/3 (tiered, recorded, never verified — verification is Tier-1's).

fact_sheet_ref.description: kb_id of the Fact Sheet card the claim was verified against (or failed to find). Whitelisted against the catalog by code.

reasons.description: The verifier's reasons, quoting the deciding words; on waiver, the original verdict is preserved here.

disposition.description: Code-derived from status by the B34(2) mapping — mirrors the run-log validation.result vocabulary. requires-review is derived, never model-self-reported.

findings.description: All checks' findings for this section, deduped by finding_id (B34(12)). A finding's message carries its reason — a boolean that cannot say why is a defect.

finding_id.description: Deterministic: {check}:{rule}:{section_id}[:{slot_id}] — waivers and acknowledgements key on it.

rule.description: One rule, one owning check — the rule→check bijection is test-asserted (no-double-report).

disposition.description: Only claim_audit findings may carry block (B34(4), enforced at the emit_validation choke point).

red_team.description: ADVISORY per-section score from the Buyer Red-Team (0–10, code-clamped). Recorded honestly — advisory means no gate consumes it, not that the record lies (B34(9)).
